name: CCBench
intro: CCBench是一个用于评估AI编程代理在真实世界任务中表现的基准测试，这些任务基于小型代码库（<10k LoC），且不属于大型语言模型训练数据的一部分。所有任务均来源于CodeCrafters用户的私有提交，CodeCrafters是一个工程师通过从零开始实现流行软件来参与挑战的平台。
build_method: 私有CodeCrafters提交筛选、Harbor任务封装、员工手写测试、参考解与Oracle可解性验证
eval_feature: 私有来源降低训练污染、真实小型代码库、可执行官方测试、公开任务与日志
drawio_review_note: PASS-SEMANTICS / NATIVE-REDRAW review aligned with official CodeCrafters CCBench repository snapshot da3895ae2f5f072ac6152c32349546344802f722 (no standalone benchmark paper is published). The diagram preserves private CodeCrafters user submissions, real-world codebases under 10k LoC, detailed staged feature instructions and test information, Harbor task packaging, staff-written test runners battle-tested by hundreds of thousands of users over four-plus years, a reference solution and Oracle solvability check for every task, the 187-task public release, Harbor CLI execution, binary verifier reward, aggregate success rate, and inspectable evaluation logs.
intro_en: CCBench is a benchmark for evaluating AI programming agents on real-world tasks based on small codebases (<10k LoC) that are not part of large language model training data. All tasks come from private submissions by CodeCrafters users, a platform where engineers participate in challenges by implementing popular software from scratch.
